13:00.headline: What a fit score really means
13:00.topic: Product education: how to read a fit score (estimate, not an offer)

graphic.headline: What a fit score *really means*
items: DO: Read it as an estimate
DO: Use it to build his list
DON'T: Treat it as an offer

captions.facebook:
A fit score is a starting point, not a verdict.

When parents first see their son's numbers compared with typical recruiting ranges for D1, D2, D3, NAIA and JUCO, it's natural to read it as a prediction. Here's a better way to use it:

✅ Read it as an estimate built from measurable things like exit velo, 60 time, velocity and grades.
✅ Use it to build a smarter target list, so his emails go to programs where he's more likely to fit.
❌ Don't treat it as an offer. Only a coach can evaluate and recruit him.
❌ Don't skip coach feedback. What coaches say after camps and visits matters more than any score.

Has a number ever changed how your family thought about which schools to target?
